BlackRock Enhanced Large Cap Core Fund, Inc. (CII) 이사인 W. Carl Kester는 2026년 10월 1일에 BlackRock Deferred Compensation Plan에 따라 발생한 28.15 Performance Rights를 취득했습니다. 거래 후 보고된 그의 직접 보유 포지션은 3,489.99 Performance Rights였습니다. 각 권리는 펀드 1주 몫의 현금가치에 해당하며, 해당 권리는 Kester가 선택한 이연 기간 동안 100% 현금으로 결제됩니다. Rule 10b5-1 계획은 보고되지 않았습니다.

Performance Rights F1, F2, F3

Holdings After Transaction: Performance Rights — 3,489.99 contracts (Direct)

F1. The Performance Rights were accrued under the BlackRock Deferred Compensation Plan.

F2. One Performance Right is convertible into the cash value of one share of BlackRock Enhanced Large Cap Core Fund, Inc.

F3. The Performance Rights are to be settled 100% in cash at the deferral period chosen by the reporting person.

Performance Rights acquired 28.15 Performance Rights Award on October 1, 2026

Reported transaction price 23.99 per share Performance Rights transaction

Direct Performance Rights following transaction 3,489.99 Performance Rights Reported position after the October 1, 2026 transaction

Cash settlement 100% Settlement at the deferral period chosen by the reporting person

Performance rights are conditional awards that give employees or executives the promise of receiving company shares or cash only if the business meets specific targets or survives for a set period. They work like a bonus you only get when certain goals are hit, so they matter to investors because they can increase the number of shares outstanding (dilution), signal management’s incentives and confidence in future results, and affect per-share earnings and valuation.
